text:
sophia: Quick heads-up 1: launch posts + webinar drove sessions up ~350% but MQLs only +2%. Can we triage before Monday's KPI sync?
rahul: Yikes. Which cohort is underperforming? paid, organic, or partners?
evan: Quick sample shows a big chunk labeled 'social' with no utm_source. Ran a tiny check: select count(*) filter (where utm_source is null) as no_utm, count(*) as total from sessions where occurred_at > now() - interval '36 hours'; result ~25% no_utm.
claire: We used three shortlinks for reels and a partner embed. I remember toggling a redirect template before push. Could be stripping query strings.
ops-bot: short-link-service deployed (sha: aa9f3) at 09:12 UTC 1 preserved_qs=false in canary.
sophia: Ok action list: 1) flip preserve_qs=true (claire) 2) backfill click->session to recover UTMs (evan) 3) add an "unattributed_pct" tile to KPI dashboard and snapshot pre/post (rahul).
claire: Pushed PR: https://git.company/shortener/pull/553 1 set preserve_qs=true; running canary.
evan: Backfill job kicked off (job id bf-342999-01). Plan: map shortener click ids -> session ids via linker logs, then backfill utm fields. Expect ~60-70% recovery. ETA ~5h. Dropping interim CSV to /reports/launch_backfill_partial_342999.csv
rahul: I'll add derived metric unattributed_pct = unattributed_sessions / total_sessions and set alert at 18%. Will upload a pre-backfill snapshot for the deck.
analytics-bot: Metric added: unattributed_pct. Alert rule created: marketing.unattributed_pct > 0.18 (notify #marketing, #eng-oncall).
ops-bot: Canary rolled clean. preserve_qs now true in canary at 09:40 UTC.
evan: Pre-snapshot uploaded: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3429990000_pre.png
sophia: Nice. If backfill recovers conversions we'll annotate and avoid product deep-dive; if not, we'll run a quick CTA A/B and follow-up nurture.
evan: Backfill progress: 50% matched after 2.5h (matched ~1,600 of 3,200 untagged). Posting partial results to /reports/launch_backfill_partial_342999.csv
claire: Added a sticky to the launch playbook: "verify preserve_qs for all campaign shortlinks".
evan: Backfill complete: matched 2,180 of 3,200 (~68%). Adjusted MQL conversion +2.3 percentage points. Post snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3429990000_post.png
rahul: Great recovery. I'll include a one-line note in Monday's KPI slide: "Initial undercount due to shortlink query stripping; post-backfill numbers shown."
sophia: Also, let's keep the unattributed_pct tile on the main KPI page and monitor. If it exceeds 25% for >1h, notify product and eng oncall.
analytics-bot: Added monitor: marketing.unattributed_pct > 0.25 for 60m triggers alert to #marketing and #eng-oncall.
sophia: Thanks team 1 leaving this thread as the canonical record for the launch attribution work. :thumbsup:
